title: Taikou Risshiden II
overview:
Experience the rise of Taiko Hideyoshi! Can you defeat worthy rivals and fulfill the dream of ruling the realm?

A groundbreaking game that lets you experience the life of Toyotomi Hideyoshi, who rose from a lowly foot soldier to become the ruler of the Sengoku era. Can you use your wits to carry out your lord's orders and become the ruler of the realm? Software that lets you enjoy the appeal of both RPG and SLG.

太閤・秀吉の立身出世ぶりを体験！
好敵手を打ち破り、天下取りの夢は果たせるか？

一介の足軽からついには戦国の覇者となった豊臣秀吉の生涯が実感できる画期的なゲームです。知恵を使って主命を果たし、天下の覇者となれるでしょうか。RPGとSLG両方の魅力が堪能できるソフトです。
